rules: Campaign map data remains authoritative for terrain, collision, navigation, entries, recovery and travel.
Verdant and Ashen visual families may differ while their semantic_base_id preserves gameplay parity.
Palette swatches and Campaign Studio debug rendering are reference evidence only and are not production tile art.
Every production visual family must bind to a real source image region before a Tile Map Studio manifest can be approved.
Art bindings may change pixels and presentation but may not silently change collision, navigation or portal semantics.
